title: HC-trafficdiff_model
summary: A traffic-data diffusion-model research project that benchmarks its generative model against tabular synthesizer baselines, bundling vendored copies of tab-ddpm, CTGAN, and CausalDiffTab research code. Its evaluation pipeline directly instantiates SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer (fit/sample) and computes evaluate_quality scores, running SDV's single-table synthesizers as comparison baselines.
